content: Do we have something similar to docs#Std.Format.pretty but where w is "infinite", i.e. so that the result has no new lines?

This issue has kept arising in various guises in the meantime, especially in infoview messages where weird line breaks appear when pretty-printing expressions/syntax that are not intended to be suggestions.

It would be nice to have w := 0 mean "infinite width"/"do not insert new lines", and for the width to be controllable in all the relevant places by the corresponding set_option format.width (which exists, but is not respected during MessageData formatting).
(Btw, maybe the message topic name should be about newlines specifically instead of whitespace in general, which I think we want to keep... :grinning_face_with_smiling_eyes:)
I'll also crosslink this to #Editors & UIs > Width of MessageData in InfoView (VS Code) .
I couldn't find an RFC, so I made one here: #lean4 > RFC: pretty-printing with infinite width
